name: Paid Newsletter (Substack / Beehiiv)

yield.notes: Substack takes 10% of paid subscriptions. Beehiiv has flat fee model. $5-15/mo subscription price typical.

flags: Audience-dependent: starting from zero is very slow

prerequisites: A specific expertise or consistent perspective
startup_checklist: Choose a focused, specific topic you can write about weekly
Set up Substack or Beehiiv (Beehiiv preferred for monetization tools)
Write 5 free issues before launching paid tier to demonstrate quality
Set paid subscription price ($5-15/mo) with a clear value prop
Cross-post or repurpose content on Twitter/LinkedIn to grow free list
failure_modes: Subscriber growth stalls at <100 — too few to monetize
Writing quality inconsistency causes subscriber churn
Topic too niche to attract paying audience
kill_criteria: Fewer than 50 paid subscribers after 12 months of consistent publishing
sources_note: Earnings ranges from Substack creator data and community surveys.
